text:
Sanjay: Morning — anyone able to confirm APAC GPU pool availability overnight? Need ~8 A100-ish slots for a customer demo at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. PR to bump tenant quota is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4387. Terraform apply is blocked on quota. Tagging @Anya and ops :wave:
Anya: Looking now — pinging vendor on standby. Which region exactly, SG or JP?
Sanjay: SG (apac-southeast1). Prefer non-preemptible but could accept mix with spot if we can guarantee >=6/8 for a 2h window. Cost ok.
Lucy: Quick FYI — finance has flagged large overnight bursts historically. If sustained >6, they want a heads-up. @Taylor fyi.
Taylor: I can approve a one-off budget but need a short estimate. Can you share expected run time and model size/seq len? Also any chance to reduce peak concurrency?
Sanjay: Expected run is ~90m with ~8 concurrent workers, model ~70B, seq len ~1024. We can try a lighter quantized fallback if needed.
Anya: Vendor responded — they have 12-slot standby but need a formal reservation. Opening ticket VN-8921, ETA ~2h to confirm. I'll attach the reserve once confirmed.
devops-bot: Reservation draft created: VN-8921. Contact: vendor-oncall@thirdparty.com. Tentative window 03:00-05:00 UTC. Requested slots: 8 (mix allowed). Ticket: https://vendor.example/tickets/VN-8921
Phil: Infra review: PR looks fine but I need the reservation ticket referenced in the PR before merging. @Sanjay can you add `reserve:VN-8921` to the PR description?
Sanjay: Done — added `reserve:VN-8921` tag and updated PR description with ticket link. Also pasted the tiny TF snippet we're using:
```
module "tenant_quota" {
  source = "./modules/tenant_quota"
  quota  = 8
}
```
Anya: Vendor confirmed: non-preemptible 6 + 2 spot buffer. I'll update VN-8921. Note for ops: if spots evict, fallback to `model-quantized-light` and scale replicas down to 6.
Taylor: Thanks — budget approved for that window. Please ping me if we end up >2h or need >8 slots.
devops-bot: Ticket VN-8921 moved to RESERVED state. We'll post a final confirmation once infra merge completes. Closing ops loop here unless something blocks. :white_check_mark:
